name: syndicate
description: Worker serving the Synthesizer data API and the Syndicate portal.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/assets/syndicate/static && tailwindcss --input src/portal/app.css --output dist/assets/syndicate/static/app.css --minify && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js dist/assets/syndicate/static/htmx.min.js && cp src/portal/upload.js dist/assets/syndicate/static/upload.js
